diagnostics.message: wiki:log_leaf_litter: the engine requires places_block's block type to carry the minecraft:cardinal_direction and growth block states, and refuses to place (with a content-log error) when it does not. This bench has no per-block-type state registry, so it cannot check that: it assumes both states exist and places "minecraft:leaf_litter" with both set. If the real game logs "did not have the required block state" for this feature, that is the gap firing.
